# Oracle JET application since 18.1.0 

> This is a recent brief documentation for modern Oracle JET application development.


## References

The followings provide helpful and concise resources to assist with creating and implementing JET application.

- [MVVM Style Guide](https://filedn.com/lbsYLWsJM7Dh5cY9ya2mrWV/mosk/llms/ojet/mvvm-guide.md): guide to develop MVVM JET application in JavaScript.
- [VDOM Style Guide](https://filedn.com/lbsYLWsJM7Dh5cY9ya2mrWV/mosk/llms/ojet/vdom-guide.md): guide to develop modern VDOM JET application in Preact/Typescript.

JET core-pack UI components:

- [oj-c-button.md](https://filedn.com/lbsYLWsJM7Dh5cY9ya2mrWV/mosk/llms/ojet/elements/oj-c-button.md)
- [oj-c-dialog.md](https://filedn.com/lbsYLWsJM7Dh5cY9ya2mrWV/mosk/llms/ojet/elements/oj-c-dialog.md)
